To find out how much sugar Mason needs, we can break the problem down into two parts: the sugar needed for the suckers and the sugar needed for the fudge.

1. **Calculate sugar for suckers:**
   Mason needs 30 ounces of sugar for one batch of suckers. He wants to make 8 batches.
   $$\text{Sugar for suckers} = 8 \text{ batches} \times 30 \text{ ounces/batch} = 240 \text{ ounces}$$

2. **Calculate sugar for fudge:**
   Mason needs 70 ounces of sugar to make 1 batch of fudge.
   $$\text{Sugar for fudge} = 1 \text{ batch} \times 70 \text{ ounces/batch} = 70 \text{ ounces}$$

3. **Calculate total sugar:**
   Add the sugar needed for both items together.
   $$\text{Total sugar} = 240 \text{ ounces} + 70 \text{ ounces} = 310 \text{ ounces}$$

Final answer: 310
